command: BGE_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD=1 HF_HOME=<path>/hf_cache CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m app.eval.llm_query_arms --dataset fiqa --data-dir <path>/data --rerank-cache <path>/fiqa.jsonl --out bench/results/beir_fiqa_llm_query_arms.json

embedder.doc_embeddings: read from the on-disk cache (an earlier run computed them)

bar.name: M46's declared bar
bar.metric: nDCG@10 (BEIR: graded qrels, beir.graded_ndcg_at_k; fixture: file-level gold paths, aggregate_retrieval)
bar.comparison: each arm minus its exact parent (same run, same queries, same first stage, same reranker shape; the LLM step is the only switch)

parents.P1: hybrid+bge-rerank@bge-small/fp32-512/top20: bge-reranker-v2-m3 over the fused top 20 against the ORIGINAL query, max_length 512, fp32, tail in fused order

bar.interval: paired percentile bootstrap over queries: 2000 resamples, seed 0, 95%, one index matrix per dataset scope (app/eval/stats.py); each interval computed once and stored rounded to 4 decimals (delta, lo, hi) and raw (delta_raw, lo_raw, hi_raw)
bar.verdict: from the RAW bounds: 'above zero' when lo_raw > 0, 'below zero' when hi_raw < 0, 'covers zero' otherwise (a bound exactly 0.0 covers zero); stored in the comparison block, and every reader uses the stored word
bar.passes: 'above zero' on SciFact AND 'above zero' on FiQA AND not 'below zero' on the fixture's held-out half; 'open' when a cell is missing; 'withheld' when a dataset's parents did not reproduce
bar.why_the_fixture_needs_only_not_a_loss: the held-out half has 68 questions and P1 is near the fixture's ceiling there (--bar prints P1's held-out nDCG@10 and Recall@50 from small_rerankers.json)
bar.also_reported: M43's stricter reading, above zero on all three, as a column; not a decision
bar.applies_to: every LLM arm of qwen3.5:27b and gemma4:26b; the placement decision uses qwen3.5:27b, gemma4:26b replicates
bar.verdict_words_only: the qwen3.5:122b stretch rows, the heuristic stand-in rows, the qwen2.5:7b rows and every secondary comparison

datasets.fixture: fixture v1, held-out half: the test half of rerank_arms.split_questions (68); the tune half and all 136 reported beside it, no choice made on either
datasets.never_scored: no BEIR train or dev query is scored for the record

bar.multiplicity: no correction, as elsewhere in the repository; each results file stores n_intervals by kind

not_measured.multiquery post: an RRF re-sort after the reranker overrides it, which HyDE's post-rerank arm already shows
not_measured.corrective pre: the reranker re-sorts the head and undoes a demotion

request.overflow_guard: a call is prompt-overflowed when prompt_eval_count + num_predict > OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, or the shard's server log reports a truncated prompt; it is counted and treated as failed
request.retries: a transport error is retried at most twice; there is no retry for content (temperature 0 repeats itself)
request.load_check: the job exits 5 unless /api/ps reports size == size_vram and the server log reports every layer offloaded

truncation.hyde: used as written: it is still a passage
truncation.multiquery: the lines completed before the cut are used; the cut line is dropped
truncation.decompose: the lines completed before the cut are used; the cut line is dropped
truncation.rewrite: used only if its first line ended before the cut; otherwise there is no rewrite
truncation.grade: parsed from its first word as usual

declaration.rule: between D0 and D1: (a) only NUM_PREDICT (syntax tree), (b) parser fixes the probe showed, (c) byte-identical, (d) only a wiring bug the probe exposed with a failing test first, (e) plumbing; after D1 parts (a)-(d) are frozen

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over queries, one index matrix shared by all configs (paired deltas)

permutation.method: paired sign-flip of the per-query differences, one sign matrix per scope (numpy RandomState(seed).randint(0, 2)), two-sided, p = (1 + #|mean| >= |observed|) / (1 + n)

does_not_show: Retrieval ranking only: no answer quality (M47), no end-to-end latency on the demo host.
The intervals cover query sampling only. There is one temperature-0 generation per prompt on one GPU type, so the variability of LLM outputs, prompts and hardware is not in any interval.

One prompt per technique, untuned and shared by all datasets. The HyDE paper used per-task instructions, so these rows are a lower bound for prompt-engineered variants. SciFact's queries are claims, not questions; the prompts are used as written. Prompt sensitivity is not measured.
Two Q4_K_M open models served by Ollama, temperature 0, reasoning off. Not API frontier models, not reasoning on.

Latency on HPC GPUs, one request at a time, Q4 weights, prompt caching as Ollama does it. Five grader calls run in sequence where a server could batch them. Cost is in tokens and GPU seconds, not dollars.
Pretraining exposure to BEIR or the repository cannot be excluded. The audit bounds verbatim copying and path mentions only.
Fixture v1 is synthetic and small (61 files, 71 chunks, 68 held-out questions) and near its ceiling. A tie on the 68-question held-out half is not evidence of no effect.
bge-small as the first stage only. A stronger embedder (M41's Qwen3-Embedding-8B) may leave less room.

bge-reranker-v2-m3 is the only reranker. M43's hybrid+mxbai-rerank-large-v2@bge-small/fp32-512/top20 row is above P1 on both BEIR sets in the committed files, so a stronger reranker may leave less room.
On FiQA, P0 (hybrid@bge-small) is below dense@bge-small in beir_fiqa.json. A no-rerank win against P0 there is not a win against the best committed no-LLM first stage (see the secondary column).
The HyDE post-rerank row is one wiring (an RRF re-sort that overrides the reranker), not post-rerank HyDE in general.
The corrective grader is an ungated component: it has no calibration, and its quality is seen only through its effect on rankings and the descriptive agreement with qrels.
One-round corrective, binary grader, no web search, G = 5 only. No combinations of techniques. Multi-query post-rerank and corrective pre-rerank are not measured. No multiplicity correction.
